resources.string: Tap ⓘ next to an item to see what it does.
Choose the app language: Azerbaijani, Turkish, English, Russian or Arabic. Opens the Android language settings for this app (Android 13+).
On this Android version, change the language in the system settings.
The site used when you type words instead of an address (DuckDuckGo, Google, Bing, Brave, Startpage or your own).
Dark, light or system theme, accent colour and the home page background.
The page opened by the Home button. Leave nova://home to use the built-in Nibras home page.
Show your saved sites as tiles on the home page. nibrascode.com always stays there.
Show your latest (non-private) visits on the home page.
Reopen your normal tabs when the app starts. Private tabs are never restored.
Open new tabs in the desktop version of websites.
Which device the browser tells websites it is (user-agent). Useful when a site works only on a certain system.
On metered connections, blocks heavy images and stops videos from playing by themselves.
Puts unused background tabs to sleep (more than 4 open) to save RAM. They reload when you return.
Moves the address bar to the bottom so you can reach it with one hand.
Shows tabs in a row at the top, like on a computer, for one-tap switching.
Keeps audio and podcasts playing when you switch tabs or turn off the screen.
What happens when a link wants to open another app (for example a map or a store).
Ad & tracker blocking, HTTPS-only, anti-fingerprinting, secure DNS (DoH), proxy, cookies, biometric lock and encrypted backup.
Send open tabs and bookmarks to another device on the same Wi-Fi by scanning a QR code. No cloud server is used.
Add your own JavaScript or CSS for chosen sites, like browser extensions. For advanced users.
Follow news sites and blogs without ads. Feeds are fetched directly from the sites you add.
What data the app keeps (only on your device) and which services it contacts.
A web page explaining every feature of Nibras Nova.
Your history, bookmarks and settings are stored only on this device.
Tap to open · long-press to edit
